original_context: Luca does not build strong relationships.
All wise individuals show empathy and make sacrifices.
For anyone who listens actively and communicates effectively, they can build strong relationships.
If someone gains trust, then they communicate effectively and show empathy.
If Luca either leads by example or values honesty (but not both), then he gains trust.
If Luca cultivates self-discipline, then he respects traditions and values honesty.
For Luca, either pursuing spiritual growth or cultivating self-discipline (but not both) leads to embodying compassion.
For Luca, either he pursues spiritual growth or serves others, but not necessarily both.
For Luca, either he pursues personal gain or he seeks community recognition, but not both.
For Luca, either he pursues personal gain or he upholds moral values, but not both.
conclusion: Luca serves others and upholds moral values.
